perfumes.name: Delina
perfumes.lvl2: 4 to 5 tons of roses for 1 kg of rose oil
perfumes.ritual: Hair perfume · Body cream · Body oil · Hand cream · Shower gel · Candle
perfumes.insp: A tribute to the refinement of the ladies of the Court: their gowns brushing through the flowerbeds of the château inspired its luminous rose.
perfumes.quote: a tribute to women inspired by the refinement of the ladies of the Court
perfumes.comp: Juicy lychee and rhubarb open onto a Damascena rose, on a soft trail of cashmeran and musks.

perfumes.name: Delina La Rosée
perfumes.signature: A luminous rose bathed in the morning dew.
perfumes.lvl2: “La Rosée” means the morning dew
perfumes.ritual: Delina line: hair perfume · body cream · body oil · hand cream
perfumes.insp: Morning dew on rose petals: the purity of a Damascena rose at dawn, a nod to the beauty rituals of the Age of Enlightenment.
perfumes.quote: I imagined Delina La Rosée as a morning caress
perfumes.comp: Lychee and pear bring light to a Damascena rose and peony, resting on velvety white musks.

perfumes.name: Delina Exclusif
perfumes.signature: A mysterious rose in the evening.
perfumes.lvl2: Frankincense from Somalia, tapped by hand
perfumes.ritual: Delina line: hair perfume · body cream · body oil · hand cream
perfumes.insp: Delina at nightfall: a deep Damascena rose blooming in the gardens of the Château de Marly as the light fades.
perfumes.quote: I imagined Delina Exclusif as a rose at dusk
perfumes.comp: Lychee and pear melt into a rose deepened by incense, wrapped in musks and warm vanilla.

perfumes.name: Valaya
perfumes.signature: A pure burst of bright and creamy white flowers.
perfumes.lvl1: Cotton on skin, the secret petticoat
perfumes.lvl2: The whole mandarin is used: peel and pulp
perfumes.insp: The feeling of a linen veil on the skin: soft, luminous and full of contrast.
perfumes.quote: a sensual and elegant perfume brimming with contrast
perfumes.comp: Sparkling mandarin and white peach lead to creamy white flowers, on white musks and akigalawood.

perfumes.name: Valaya Exclusif
perfumes.signature: The ultimate expression of true elegance.
perfumes.lvl2: Almond, the delicacy of Versailles confectioners
perfumes.ritual: Valaya line: hair perfume · body cream
perfumes.insp: Valaya at its most elegant: pure white flowers wrapped in a powdery, almond softness.
perfumes.quote: the ultimate expression of true elegance
perfumes.comp: Almond and mandarin open onto white flowers, settling on sandalwood, akigalawood and white musks.

perfumes.name: Athénaïs
perfumes.lvl2: One flower, two faces: neroli and orange blossom absolute
perfumes.insp: A flamboyant, liberated femininity, where history meets the woman of today.
perfumes.quote: the feminine energy that fascinates as much as it liberates
perfumes.comp: Neroli and yuzu sparkle over a luminous orange blossom, on a warm, powdery tonka bean.

perfumes.name: Palatine
perfumes.signature: A modern and sophisticated Marly violet.
perfumes.lvl2: A violet recreated by headspace
perfumes.insp: A daring, contemporary violet for women who embrace what makes them unique.
perfumes.quote: a statement to all women who are not afraid to embrace their uniqueness
perfumes.comp: Mandarin and pear lift a powdery violet, resting on sandalwood, musks and praline.

perfumes.name: Meliora
perfumes.lvl2: The raspberry comes from a single molecule
perfumes.insp: Light and uplifting: a playful, elegant rose that lifts the mood.
perfumes.comp: Zesty raspberry and blackcurrant open onto rose and ylang-ylang, on a soft woody vanilla.

perfumes.name: Oriana
perfumes.lvl1: Chantilly, the delight of the court
perfumes.lvl2: Marshmallow + orange blossom = a Chantilly effect
perfumes.insp: A gourmand delight: luminous white flowers melting into a soft, sweet trail.
perfumes.comp: Sparkling mandarin leads to orange blossom and jasmine, on marshmallow, praline and musks.

perfumes.name: Cassili
perfumes.lvl2: [to complete]
perfumes.insp: Joyful and soft: ripe fruits and flowers settling into creamy woods.
perfumes.comp: Peach and plum burst open with mimosa, before a comforting trail of sandalwood and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Athalia
perfumes.lvl2: [to complete]
perfumes.insp: Mysterious and enigmatic: a captivating trail with a quiet intensity.
perfumes.comp: Bitter orange and incense open onto iris and orange blossom, on amber, suede and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Safanad
perfumes.lvl2: [to complete]
perfumes.insp: Warm and enveloping: a velvety orange blossom with a soft, radiant glow.
perfumes.comp: Orange and pear bring light to orange blossom and jasmine, on ambrox, vanilla and sandalwood.

perfumes.name: Layton
perfumes.lvl2: An unexpected duo: baked apple and patchouli
perfumes.insp: Masculine elegance for a confident, charming man who loves life's finer things.
perfumes.quote: a nod to the masculine elegance
perfumes.comp: Fresh apple meets calming lavender, wrapped in the earthy depth of patchouli and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Layton Exclusif
perfumes.lvl2: [to complete]
perfumes.insp: Layton pushed further: bolder and more intense, for those who seek the extraordinary.
perfumes.quote: crafted for those who pursue truly extraordinary experiences
perfumes.comp: Bergamot and lavender give way to a deep base of oud, sandalwood and leather.

perfumes.name: Althaïr
perfumes.lvl2: The vanilla flower blooms one day and is hand-pollinated
perfumes.insp: A new take on vanilla, the noble ingredient of the Enlightenment: majestic, subtle and surprisingly fresh.
perfumes.quote: a majestic, subtle and surprisingly fresh vanilla
perfumes.comp: Bourbon vanilla and praline, lit up by orange blossom and warmed with cinnamon and cardamom.

perfumes.name: Althaïr Exclusif
perfumes.lvl2: Saffron: 200,000 flowers for 1 kg
perfumes.insp: Music in 18th-century France: grand, festive concerts at Versailles, and private, intimate performances at the Château de Marly. Althaïr Exclusif plays on that contrast.
perfumes.quote: a perfume composed like a concerto
perfumes.comp: Built on the notes of the iconic Althaïr, made deeper with saffron and amaretto, around an even richer Bourbon vanilla.

perfumes.name: Percival
perfumes.base: Fir Balsam · Tonka Bean · Ambrox · White Musks
perfumes.signature: The quiet confidence of smelling good, every day.
perfumes.lvl2: Grasse lavender, picked just before it blooms
perfumes.insp: The royal blue of its bottle, the colour of the kings of France: a new, noble freshness.
perfumes.quote: a noble scent echoing the symbolical colour of French kings
perfumes.comp: Bergamot and lavender, softened by iris and the warm sensuality of tonka bean.

perfumes.name: Haltane
perfumes.lvl2: Perfumers call oud “black gold”
perfumes.insp: The elegant lifestyle of the guests of the Château de Marly, reimagined for the gentleman of today.
perfumes.quote: inspired by the elegant lifestyle of the guests of the Château de Marly
perfumes.comp: Bergamot and lavender reveal a praline heart, deepening into oud and supple leather.

perfumes.name: Herod
perfumes.lvl2: Tobacco, a treasure of the 18th-century elite
perfumes.insp: Prestigious and opulent: the warmth of spices and tobacco leaves.
perfumes.comp: Spicy cinnamon opens onto a deep heart of tobacco leaves, settling on warm vanilla.

perfumes.name: Perseus
perfumes.signature: The radiant freshness of Marly mornings.
perfumes.lvl2: Vetiver’s hidden citrus side
perfumes.insp: Bright and invigorating, with a refined elegance.
perfumes.comp: Bright grapefruit and fresh geranium over refined vetiver and amber woods.

perfumes.name: Castley
perfumes.lvl2: Timut pepper, rare and delicate
perfumes.insp: An ode to free and intrepid spirits: the allure of the modern explorer who shapes his own destiny.
perfumes.quote: a surprising impression of movement as well as balance
perfumes.comp: Bergamot, ginger and Timut pepper over a warm base of labdanum and akigalawood.

perfumes.name: Sedley
perfumes.signature: The fountains of Marly in motion.
perfumes.lvl2: The icy effect comes from one molecule, Hivernal Neo
perfumes.insp: Fresh and energising, like a breath of mint and citrus.
perfumes.comp: Spearmint and citrus meet aromatic lavandin, resting on sandalwood.

perfumes.name: Greenley
perfumes.lvl2: A fruity freshness that lasts surprisingly long
perfumes.insp: Fresh and soothing, from crisp green apple to warm woods.
perfumes.comp: Green apple opens onto a noble petitgrain, unfolding into ambrox and amber woods.

perfumes.name: Pegasus
perfumes.lvl2: Addictive almond at the heart of a masculine scent
perfumes.insp: An ode to elegance and confidence.
perfumes.quote: an ode to elegance and confidence
perfumes.comp: Radiant bergamot softened by almond, unfolding into a warm vanilla base.

perfumes.name: Pegasus Exclusif
perfumes.lvl2: [to complete]
perfumes.insp: Pegasus at its most powerful: charismatic and assertive.
perfumes.comp: Pink pepper and almond deepen into a woody trail of oud and vanilla.

perfumes.name: Carlisle
perfumes.lvl2: [to complete]
perfumes.insp: Explosive and captivating, with an intense depth.
perfumes.comp: Crisp apple and tonka bean, settling into a warm, deep patchouli.

perfumes.name: Godolphin
perfumes.lvl2: [to complete]
perfumes.insp: Unbound and vigorous: the power of noble leather.
perfumes.comp: Warm saffron reveals a noble leather, unfolding into an intense amber base.

perfumes.name: Galloway
perfumes.lvl2: [to complete]
perfumes.insp: Pure and bright, with an elegant freshness.
perfumes.comp: Zesty lemon with a spicy freshness, resting on ambrox and musks.

perfumes.name: Oajan
perfumes.lvl2: [to complete]
perfumes.insp: Sensual and warm, wrapped in honey and amber.
perfumes.comp: Honey and cinnamon open onto amber and labdanum, settling on vanilla and tonka bean.

perfumes.name: Kalan
perfumes.lvl2: [to complete]
perfumes.insp: Fiery and splendid, with a luxurious warmth.
perfumes.comp: Blood orange and black pepper meet aromatic lavender, grounded by radiant cedarwood.

perfumes.name: Crécy
perfumes.signature: A refined masculinity where elegance, strength and sensuality coexist.
perfumes.lvl2: Burgundy blackcurrant buds: 30 kg for 1 kg of absolute
perfumes.insp: Sensuality beyond convention: a confident elegance, between strength and subtlety.
perfumes.quote: confident elegance, balancing strength with subtlety
perfumes.comp: An aromatic rose and blackcurrant bud over an addictive woody base.

perfumes.name: Valero
perfumes.lvl2: Bourbon geranium, named after the royal house
perfumes.insp: An ode to visionaries: a pure, structured fougère, born of a desire to pass things on.
perfumes.quote: stoked by a desire for purity and transmission
perfumes.comp: Bourbon geranium and lavender over the warmth of sandalwood and the depth of ambrox.

perfumes.name: Carios
perfumes.top: Bergamot · Pink Peppercorn · Red Mandarin · Saffron
perfumes.base: Cedarwood · Ambrox · Vetiver · Roasted Tonka Bean
perfumes.lvl2: Roasted tonka: only 60 to 100 tons a year worldwide
perfumes.insp: A sovereign trail that breaks the rules and makes an instant impression.
perfumes.quote: an extremely powerful trail that breaks the rules
perfumes.comp: Red mandarin and red thyme meet roasted tonka beans in a luminous, ambery fougère.

perfumes.name: Eragon
perfumes.base: Leather · Tonka Bean · Vanilla Bean · Patchouli
perfumes.signature: Deep yet radiant, spicy yet smooth.
perfumes.lvl2: Cinnamon, once worth more than gold in China
perfumes.insp: The creative source: a tension between light and depth, made for fearless creators.
perfumes.quote: born of a desire for tension between light and depth
perfumes.comp: Patchouli, cinnamon and vanilla in a radiant, deep ambery-spicy trail.

K1: “Versailles for my Court, Marly for my friends” · Louis XIV
At Marly, you kept your hat on
K2: 1743 · The Marly horses on the bottle
Perfume · The one thing rank did not dictate
